output.revised_prompt:
Create an original portrait 2:3 mobile slot-game lobby background designed to sit behind live UI cards. High-end photorealistic 3D commercial game key art: a joyful, elegant, welcoming soft-luxury casino gaming lounge in cream, champagne gold, deep burgundy, pearl white, and soft rose gold, with restrained emerald and ruby accents. Symmetrical one-point perspective looking toward a luminous central jackpot-style stage, but with absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, currency symbols, or recognizable brands.

Keep the CENTRAL 65% of the composition visually quiet, darker, low-contrast, and relatively uncluttered for readable overlay cards and UI. Do not place any large object in the center. Frame the image with wealth and gaming details concentrated along the left and right outer edges.

Show rows of premium, realistic slot cabinets receding along BOTH sides of the lounge, with at least four clearly distinct original cabinet designs visibly identifiable: different silhouettes, screen arrangements, bezels, topper shapes, button decks, reels/symbol layouts, and champagne/rose-gold/pearl material treatments. The cabinets must immediately communicate real slot gaming, while remaining entirely fictional and unbranded. Integrate realistic coin trays and subtle gaming controls. Any screen imagery should use only abstract gem, fruit-like, starburst, pearl, or ornamental pictograms—no writing and no numeric characters.

Architecture and decor: burgundy carpet guiding the perspective, pearl-studded marquee arches, warm bulb ceiling treatments, champagne-metal reflections, elegant display plinths along the outer edges containing pearls, emeralds, rubies, diamonds, and tasteful coin-like decorative discs without currency markings. Gentle festive sparkles, polished realistic materials, rich but soft glamour. Warm diffused marquee glow, inviting energetic gambling-floor atmosphere, no harsh neon and no smoky darkness.

No people or characters. Avoid an empty palace or temple feeling; this must read instantly as an active premium slot-machine lobby. Avoid nightclub aesthetics, cheap yellow plastic, cluttered center, flat vector styling, oversized foreground props, text-like markings, watermarks, and copied cabinet designs. Vertical composition, polished cinematic depth, premium mobile game background, realistic global illumination and soft reflections.
